Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:Fuel Oil Flow Distributor
 F2901-
 Type 4

Roper Pump Company,
 Georgia,
 USA
Introduction

This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which performed on an annually 
bases indicated by Y1 or at fuel oil leaks as indicated in the title block

The distributor pumping distributes the light fuel oil with its 10 pump 
elements to the 10 corresponding turbine fuel nozzles and proportional to the speed at which the unit operates

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Elhamied 
 Abu Zid, tested by eng. 
Ayman 
Elmor, revised by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil: EDEPC 
 inspection & quality control general 
 director, approved by eng. 
 Sawsan Ellithy: general 
 director of Port Said GT.

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety, shoes, eye glass ... etc
Ensure that the equipment shutdown.
Light fuel oil not under pressure and no flow rate..

Complete maintenance tool set as (suitable wrenches set, screw

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Light Fuel Oil Leaks

The equipment must be 
shutdown and ensure that the bypass valve is opened and not under pressure.

Tighten fittings without 
using Teflon tape as manufacturer instructions.

Take care in tightening in 
order to prevent cracking and or stripping threads.

No excess weight (loads) 
can be placed on the equipment during retightening.

sections.text: The Equipment does not Pumping

Remove socket head plug in 
face plate and turn shaft with screw driver.

If the shaft is broken the 
equipment is reinstalled by a new one.

Change the spare part 
element by a new one if damaged.

Check (bypass valve, main 
pump, clutch).

sections.text: Magnetic Pickup Clearance

Remove pipe plugs located 
below ends of each magnetic pick up, clearance between each sensor and gear 
indicator must be within the limits specified in the manufacturer instructions 
from 0.005 to 0.010 inch (max 0.015 inch)

Torque seal do not exceed 
15 ft Ibs
